title: Housing Authority of the City of Los Angeles (HACLA) / Current Rental Assistance Programs / Measure ULA
motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council DIRECT the Los Angeles Housing Department, in coordination with the Housing Authority of the City of Los Angeles (HACLA) and any other relevant departments or agencies, to report on all rental assistance programs currently available to residents living in HACLA owned or HACLA administered properties, including those funded or supported through Measure ULA. requests.asks: All rental assistance programs currently available to residents of HACLA-owned or HACLA-administered properties, including those funded or supported through Measure ULA.
